project_type: Android app (single :app module), Kotlin, Android Auto / Car App Library + Shizuku privileged ops. Duo Screen is an experimental feature compiled only into the personal and lab flavors.
build_system: Gradle (Kotlin DSL) via ./gradlew. QUIRK: the src/duoscreen source set has NO manifest of its own — an AndroidSourceSet has one manifest slot, so Duo Screen's manifest entries (CarAppService, SettingsActivity, SpikeActivity, and the QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES permission) live inside app/src/projection/AndroidManifest.xml, which is merged into the personal/lab flavors by android.sourceSets in app/build.gradle.kts. QUIRK: duoscreen unit tests live in src/duoscreen/test and are wired into testPersonal/testLab (NOT the shared src/test) via android.sourceSets testPersonal/testLab java.srcDir. QUIRK: unit tests run with testOptions.unitTests.isReturnDefaultValues = true so android.jar stubs return defaults instead of throwing.
verification_instructions: JVM gate: ./gradlew :app:assemblePersonalDebug then ./gradlew :app:testPersonalDebugUnitTest must both pass. On-device: ./gradlew :app:installPersonalDebug, then adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -c, reproduce, then adb -s YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS logcat -d -s AutoBridgeDuoOps:* ActivityTaskManager:* ActivityStarterImpl:* XSpaceManagerServiceImpl:* (add InputDispatcher:* InputManager:* for the touch phase). Device serial YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS is connected and in `device` state (adb path: ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb).
environment_constraints: MAIN-TREE mode: all work happens in /Users/anuwat.t/Documents/ChatGPT/AutoBridge on the current branch (projection-route) which has a large volume of unrelated uncommitted work. The entire app/src/duoscreen/ tree is UNTRACKED by git. DO NOT COMMIT ANYTHING and do not disturb other uncommitted files. Device YXEMRCGYAI49S4SS, flavor personal (debug). The Duo Screen app launches BEFORE touch is exercised, so touch can only be tested after launch succeeds. The FEAT artifacts and report live under .agents/tasks/ which is outside the worktree build paths — never commit them.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md in repo. README.md and ROADMAP.md are the project docs. ROADMAP.md classifies 'Own-content and privileged display' and cross-display raw-touch landing as PARTIAL/BLOCKED and needing device runs — relevant to the touch verdict. Nothing in src/duoscreen is committed; read files directly (git diff will not show them).
key_patterns: DuoScreenShizukuOps is a stateless Kotlin `object` with no Context — it reaches IActivityTaskManager/IInputManager reflectively through a Shizuku ShizukuBinderWrapper so transactions run as the shell UID (callingPackage com.android.shell), with HiddenApiBypass lifting hidden-API restrictions. launchOnDisplay currently builds an IMPLICIT ACTION_MAIN+CATEGORY_LAUNCHER+setPackage intent (no ComponentName) and relies on shell to resolve it — this is what fails with aInfo is null on MIUI. Pure logic (DuoScreenLayout, DuoScreenLayoutCodec, DuoScreenPaneSet, DuoScreenInputRouter) is framework-free and JVM-unit-tested with plain JUnit (org.junit.Test / org.junit.Assert.*). Context-holding resolution belongs in DuoScreenController (holds a Context), keeping the object Context-free. DuoScreenSettingsActivity.pickAppFor already resolves launcher activities via packageManager.queryIntentActivities(MAIN/LAUNCHER) under the already-held QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES. InstalledAppRepository.queryLaunchableActivities (in src/main) is the pattern for the SDK 33+ ResolveInfoFlags.of(0L) vs pre-33 @Suppress(DEPRECATION) query form.
